# Philman Yeung

> Product manager and designer based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Former Microsoft Advertising PM for monetization and AI ad content safety across 70+ markets; previously Digital Product Manager at L'Oréal and co-founder of VOLTA Physiotech, a physiotherapy device startup.

Strongest in monetization, experimentation, UX and design systems. Open to Product Manager, Product Analyst, Business Analyst and Go-To-Market Product Manager roles in downtown Toronto or remote across Canada and the US.
